notes.title: Version 4.1.0 - No more tank controls!
notes.content:
After a long 2 and a half years of reflection, I’ve decided to remove the mandatory tank controls.

Thanks to those who played with this somewhat special mechanic. I believe it had some good sides to it, but it could also make the game unnecessarily difficult. I’ll let you be the judge!

[list]
[*] Optional tank controls in Episode 1, directional controls by default
[*] Directional controls in Episodes 2, 3 and 4
[*] Control change in Ep 3: you can turn by holding the inventory button
[*] Text changes in Episode 4
[/list]

tags.feature:

[*] Directional controls in Episodes 2, 3 and 4
[*] Control change in Ep 3: you can turn by holding the inventory button

notes.title: Episode 3 Now Available !
notes.content:
[h1][b]New episode available now in french and english![/b][/h1]

Go play it right now !

[list]
[*] A crazy story in space
[*] 2 Times more content than the previous episodes
[*] This episode is oriented action/adventure/exploration instead of puzzle
[*] Bosses, upgrades and special abilities
[/list]

This episode is also a love letter to a well known game franchise that marked my childhood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44180964/a09a885bcf85345d1f347cbcd8a03f2649ce8aee.png[/img]

Just like in the other episodes, the action takes place in Quebec.

Episode 1 Ville-Émard (Popular neighbour in Montreal) 
Episode 2 at St-Tite (Festival Western) 
And this one happens ... [b]in a spaceship[/b]. 

But not any spaceship. The action takes place in the same universe as a popular Quebec TV series that almost every person around my age has seen and knows...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44180964/5465aae159f74e3b6a980dbd5849d5010fa4f933.png[/img]

I really hope you enjoy the game!

Thanks,

P-A

notes.title: A new Scenario is available ! Major Update 2.2.0 !
notes.content:
[h1]A whole new playable story available now[/h1]

Hi everyone ! I have been working since releasing this game back in june to make it a series of short stories adventure games. So  the idea is to have multiple scenarios around 2 hours of gameplay each in a different cities of Quebec. 

[previewyoutube=ygCmCUYAVgY;full][/previewyoutube]

This one takes place in St-Tite Festival Western. It is even more epic than the precedent. [b]It is completed and you can play now[/b]!

All the scenarios will also be based on a cinema genre. For example the first one is horror and this one is western.
Film-noir and sci-fi coming soon !

Enjoy and thanks for playing !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44180964/a94ca9c849804eda4c795d65df13e0d9b3fa7887.png[/img]

tags.feature: A whole new playable story available now

notes.title: Version 1.0.5
notes.content:
This is only a small fix to solve a confusion problem.

When booting the game we could believe that it crashed because the screen is completely black until the player presses any buttons. 

The goal with that was to create a surprise effect in front of the black screen since it is not normal, but in return some players had the impression the game was just not working and would not continue. That's why I decided to add a title and display controls at start.

[list]
[*] Added sound effect on opening screen
[*] Added title and control display on opening screen
[/list]

[*] Added title and control display on opening screen
